file_replace_confirm: Replace the editor program? Your changes are not saved anywhere else.
continue_hint: Run until a breakpoint, input, or HALT
restart_hint: Reload the program and run it from the beginning
step_over_hint: Run the next instruction, including a complete subroutine or TRAP
step_into_hint: Run one instruction, following calls and TRAPs
step_out_hint: Run until the current subroutine or TRAP returns
reset_hint: Reload the program into clean memory
reset_keep_memory: Reset the processor and keep memory
edit_value_invalid: Enter a 16-bit value such as x3000, #12, -1, or 'A'
registers_hint: Click a value to edit it
registers_caption: Processor registers with their bits and hexadecimal, signed, and unsigned values
memory_go_to_label: Go to an address or label
memory_go_to_not_found: Address or label not found. Use a hexadecimal address such as x3000 or a label in your program.
console_hint: Click here and type to send keys to the program. The program decides whether to display them.
console_waiting: The program is waiting for a key. Type to continue.
breakpoints_empty: There are no breakpoints yet. Click the gutter next to a line, use the dot in the memory table, or add one here. The condition and hit count are optional.
watchpoints_empty: There are no watchpoints yet. A watchpoint pauses just after an instruction reads or writes the address.
error_no_address: Address or label not found. Use a hexadecimal address such as x3000 or a label in your program.
error_condition: Invalid condition. Use registers, N, Z, P, numbers such as x41 or #65, and operators such as == != < && || & |.
error_hit_count: Enter an integer of at least 1.
trace_caption: The most recent instructions, newest first, with the changes each one made
trace_running: The trace shows the most recent instructions when the machine pauses.
trace_empty: There are no instructions yet. Step or run the program to fill the trace.
registers_hint_fixed: Click a value to edit it, e.g. 0.75
upload_description: Sign in to manage the group account and its LC-3 submissions.
upload_file_hint: Maximum 1 MB. It will be saved as grupo(number).asm.
upload_overwrite: Uploading another file will replace the group's previous submission.
upload_error_group: Select one of the available groups.
upload_error_password: The password does not match this group.
upload_error_file: Select a file with the .asm extension.
upload_error_size: The file exceeds the 1 MB limit.
upload_error_unavailable: Submissions are not configured. Contact the simulator administrator.
upload_error_generic: The operation could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
group_submission_missing: The group has not uploaded a file yet.
group_password_changed: The password was updated. Sign in again with the new password.
group_password_too_short: The new password must be between 12 and 128 characters.
group_password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
admin_description: Manage accounts and view group submissions.
admin_password_once: Copy this password and give it to the group. It cannot be viewed again.
admin_error_generic: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
admin_error_rate_limit: The attempt limit has been reached. Wait 15 minutes before trying again.
